key_idea: The piece must have the same shape as the empty spot.
steps: The empty spot is in the bottom right corner of the house.
It is a step shape: low on the left and tall on the right.
Piece C is low on the left and tall on the right, so it fills the gap.

choice_feedback.A: A rectangle has a flat top, but the gap has a step.
choice_feedback.B: A square has a flat top, but the gap has a step.
choice_feedback.D: This piece is tall on the left and low on the right. That is the wrong way round.
choice_feedback.E: A triangle has a slanted side, but the gap only has square corners.
